evals.prompt: The time-zone change in dueLabel is already implemented in the invoices project (plan in docs/engineering/plans/due-label-customer-time-zone.md). Write the integration tests.
evals.expected_output: Tests are written with node:test and import through src/index.js (the public API; a library with no server, so the readiness signal is n/a); they run the label under several server time zones by starting child processes with TZ set, and pass; the same tests are run against releases/1.2.0/src (the previous release) in a scratch copy made in one chained command, where the server-zone cases fail in America/Sao_Paulo and the preserved cases pass; npm test passes with the change; the plan gains an 'Integration tests' section with both runs' count lines quoted, the full check, git worktree list and the working tree; src/ is unchanged.
assertions: New test files import dueLabel through src/index.js and use node:test
Each time-zone test starts a separate process with TZ set (a child process or `TZ=<zone> <command>`), in at least two zones, and no test assigns `process.env.TZ` inside the test process
The reply or the plan quotes the command run against releases/1.2.0/src with the runner's count lines, and names the tests that fail there
The reply or the plan quotes `npm test` with its count lines for the change

assertions.text: The plan's 'Integration tests' section carries both runs with their count lines
Neither src/due.js nor src/index.js is among the files the run produced or changed
